decision: Reject: accepted range is not supported by its quote and omits larger rates in context.

critical_errors.source_passage: Exact context includes 16.4% and 15.3% in separate add-on regimens, as well as 0% control values. The approved quote contains 0.6% and 1.6%, not 3.9%.
critical_errors.rationale: A subset of independent trial values is presented as the label range; the quoted evidence does not include its upper bound.

cases.coverage: Does not explain independent controls, background regimens or 24-week timeframe; does not answer whether a pooled risk is appropriate.
